name: Algolaser Alpha MK2 40W
tagline: 40W Premium open-frame diode focused on speed and fine engraving detail
tldr: Algolaser Alpha MK2 40W is the 40W SKU on the Algolaser algolaser alpha mk2 line. Algolaser targets makers who want faster engraving and tighter spot control than typical budget diodes. Verify optical power on the listing — do not assume combined-watt marketing.
mainObjective: Fast hobby engraving and cutting — thicker basswood, dark acrylic, and shorter job times

priceRange.note: 40W optical module — verify SKU before buying

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: Tight spot for finer detail in diode class
Fast fill engraving on optimized settings
cons: 40W optical claims need verification on your unit
Premium price vs Ortur for similar watt class
beginnerNotes: Choose 40W if it matches your typical jobs. Compare cut depth and price against other tiers in this product line before ordering.
proTips: Algolaser shines on line art and shallow fills — push speed on vectors after test burns. Use compressed spot advantage for photo engraving on coated wood.
primaryUse: Performance-oriented open-frame diode for detailed wood and leather engraving with above-average speed.
